subject: Business Studies
central_question: How does management enable people and resources to achieve organisational goals effectively, efficiently and in a coordinated manner?
in_scope_units: Management as art, science and profession

known_pitfalls.correction: Management includes planning, organising, staffing, directing and controlling.
Effectiveness concerns achieving goals; efficiency concerns achieving them with minimum resources.

known_pitfalls.claim: Coordination is a separate specialist function.
known_pitfalls.correction: Coordination is the essence of all managerial functions and the responsibility of every manager.

ncert_end_of_chapter_exercises_reference: Exercises contain Very Short Answer questions 1-5, Short Answer questions 1-6 and Long Answer questions 1-6.
